items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And at that time, there was Roy Eldridge, Dick Vance and Joe Thomas.

ctx.x: Couple of other fellows in the band but this voice I didn't know. So, Roy said that's Joe Thomas, the other trumpeter. I said, What do you mean the other trumpeter? There are three up there. And at that time, there was Roy Eldridge, Dick Vance and Joe Thomas.
That was Dick Vance, Joe Thomas and Roy Eldridge, 1st, 2nd and 3rd.
